narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates with active kinetic exchanges, a US Apache shootdown, and Iran's retaliation, while Israel prepares for two-front operations and Ukraine deepens strikes into Russia. The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline through 2026 confirms structural oil supply disruption, driving defensive positioning.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil and defense equities; short equity indices (S&P 500) and high-yield credit; increase cash and gold allocations.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The EIA's projection of a Hormuz blockade persisting through Q3 2026 and full recovery only in 2027, combined with Kuwait seeking pipeline bypasses and WTI forecast raised to $88.32, indicates a prolonged supply disruption. Capital is rotating into energy commodities and related infrastructure plays despite diplomatic noise.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI and Brent futures, energy sector ETFs, and tanker equities; short consumer discretionary and airlines.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Divergence
narratives.summary: While BTC sells off with risk assets due to macro risk-off, institutional flows show divergence: MicroStrategy buys the dip, Ethena partners with Janus Henderson for tokenized CLOs, and retail dip-buying persists. This suggests capital is selectively rotating into crypto infrastructure and yield-bearing protocols, not broad risk-on.
narratives.trade_implication: Long Bitcoin via spot ETFs on dips; long Ethena (ENA) and select DeFi tokens; short altcoins with weak fundamentals.
